textbookText: 2. Electric field at a point between two charges. Twopoint charges are separated by a distance of 10.0 cm. One has a charge of −25𝜇𝐶 and the other +50𝜇𝐶 . (a) Determine the direction and magnitude of the
electric field at a point P between the two charges that is 2.0 cm from the negative
charge (Fig.19.10 a). (b) If an electron (mass= 9.11×10-31 kg) is placed at rest at P and then released, what will be its initial acceleration (direction and magnitude)?

The electric field at P will be the vector sum of the fields created separately by Q 1 and Q2. The field due to the negative charge Q1 points toward Q1and the field due to the positive charge Q2 points away from Q2. The electric field points to the left, so the electron will feel a force to the right since it is negatively charged. Therefore, the acceleration will be to the right.
